bio: The terrace of this modern villa on the banks of the Meuse is one of the finest in the region. The knockout view through floor-to-ceiling windows gives the impression of almost floating on water. This watering hole is a favourite with regulars who appreciate its creative cuisine and superlative value for money. Examples include soufflé stuffed with a cream of gruyere and fresh tomato coulis. Well-crafted cuisine, subtle delicate sauces and the occasional surprising texture or flavour!...
